messages.content: What was your first instructor like when something went wrong?
Often impatient with both of us. I would make a small mistake, and they would ask me to try again without explaining what I had done wrong.
Do the two of you still meet?
No. I left the monastery to work with Mara, who can fix a tool. My teacher died some years ago.
